chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 488: The Martial Ancestor Returns to the Ninth Heaven
chapter_meta_description: The desiccated corpse is revealed as the Martial Ancestor, who returns to his peak ninth heaven and annihilates three ancestral gods in one chapter.
og_title: The Martial Ancestor Returns – World of Immortality Ch. 488
og_description: Li Huiyou’s time reversal backfires, restoring the Martial Ancestor to his prime. He effortlessly kills three ancestral gods in a stunning display of power.
twitter_description: The most powerful martial god of the Nine Provinces returns to the ninth heaven and crushes his enemies.
